incident.name: Marks & Spencer Ransomware
incident.description: Scattered Spider used social engineering to compromise M&S IT systems, disrupting online orders, contactless payments, and Click & Collect for weeks. Customer data including contact details and order history exposed.
incident.root_cause: Helpdesk social engineering, insufficient identity verification for privileged access
incident.lessons: Retail critical systems require phishing-resistant MFA and rigorous helpdesk verification. Scattered Spider continues targeting large enterprises.

relatedIncidents.name: Target Data Breach
relatedIncidents.description: Attackers gained access via compromised HVAC vendor credentials, stole 40M credit cards and 70M customer records.
relatedIncidents.root_cause: Third-party vendor access, flat network, no segmentation
relatedIncidents.lessons: Third-party access must be strictly controlled and segmented.

relatedIncidents.name: MGM Resorts Ransomware
relatedIncidents.description: 10-minute LinkedIn/vishing attack on IT helpdesk led to Okta compromise, then ransomware across MGM's casino operations.
relatedIncidents.root_cause: Helpdesk social engineering, insufficient identity verification
relatedIncidents.lessons: Helpdesk identity verification must be rigorous. Vishing is a critical attack vector.

relatedIncidents.name: Co-op Cyberattack
relatedIncidents.description: Co-op confirmed a significant cyberattack affecting back-office and call centre systems, with DragonForce ransomware group claiming responsibility and threatening to leak member data.
relatedIncidents.root_cause: Social engineering attack on IT helpdesk, same TTPs as M&S attack
relatedIncidents.lessons: Wave of UK retail attacks shows sector-wide vulnerability to social engineering. Industry-wide helpdesk security standards needed.
